item.name: Submits a conversion request and returns a viewer content key for document viewer rendering.

request.name: Submits a conversion request and returns a viewer content key for document viewer rendering.

description.content:
Supports document, production, image, and file-field conversion scenarios used by the Document Viewer REST API.
The returned value includes keys used to track conversion and retrieve converted content.
